items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: when I would come off from the Roxy Theatre -- the three of us -- Ben, Charlie and myself, we would walk down the street three blocks and go to work with John Kirby until four o'clock in the morning.

ctx.x: Well, you certainly have done that down through the years.

But when I sat in Barnet's band, they got burned out in California, Duke was sending them arrangements because he loved Charlie so much, and I sat in the band as if I had played in it all my life, because I knew whatever they were going to play -- I'd know it, and so Charlie never said a word to me except 'play.'
